name: Five-Coordinate Path Learning Space
definition: On coordinates $0,\ldots,4$, in low-bit integer encoding take $L_{\mathrm{path},5}=\{0,1,3,7,15,16,17,19,23,24,25,27,28,29,30,31\}$.
properties: This family is accessible and union closed, hence a learning space. Its reflected source indicators are $(\eta_0,\eta_\infty)=(0,1)$, showing that the two indicators can differ in the opposite direction from the seventeen-state nonlinear example.
